_comment: Pages appear on the index in the order they are listed here. Anything in tools/ that is not listed shows up after them, most recently changed first. Fields: title, description, hidden.

nmr-1d-explorer.html.title: Lipoate NMR Explorer
nmr-1d-explorer.html.description: Five ¹H and ¹³C spectra – ethyl lipoate, ethanol, lipoic acid, and two mixtures. Peaks assigned by Claude with overview.

ternary_mixture_explorer.html.title: Ternary Mixture Explorer
ternary_mixture_explorer.html.description: Data from a ternary mixture screening run. 16 LpOH/TFEA/acrylamide compositions in THF, plus blanks and repeats, each with UV, IR, and ¹H/¹⁹F NMR spectra.

tube-color-explorer.html.title: Color Mixing Explorer
tube-color-explorer.html.description: Data from prototype color mixing demo. 63 different mixtures of red, blue, and yellow dyes with UV-vis spectra and images.
